## About
RWB stands for red, white and blue. The company was founded by Robert W Biehle Jr, a United States Army veteran, and it is still a veteran family owned and operated electrical contractor serving Montgomery County and the surrounding areas.
We do residential and commercial work: installation, troubleshooting, repairs and upgrades. We are fully insured and state licensed, and we put in code compliant work with high-quality parts and materials.
When Ryan, Dalton or Gerrit come out to your place, they take the time to explain what they found and what they plan to do. Reviewers say it plainly: they walk you through it and make sure you understand.

## Services
- Electrical panels and circuit breakers: Breaker box repair, replacement and upgrades for homes, plus panels and circuits for businesses.
- Generator Installation & power connections: Generator installs and the connections to go with them. One reviewer says Ryan even helped him learn to run his portable generator.
- Electric car charger systems: EV charger installs. One reviewer says Ryan took time to work out the best setup and installation location.
- Dedicated outlets for generators and RVs: RV plugs and generator outlets wired where you need them. One reviewer had Ryan, Gerrit and Dalton install an RV plug.
- Interior and exterior light fixtures and fans: Indoor and outdoor lights and ceiling fans, put in clean and to code.
- Troubleshooting and repair: Breakers tripping or a circuit acting up. One reviewer says Ryan and his team tracked down a short circuit in a pergola and rewired it to code.
- Overhead and underground wiring: Wiring run overhead or underground for homes, shops and commercial sites.
- Home inspection report repairs: Buying or selling a house? We fix the electrical items on the inspection report. One reviewer says the team kept his closing timeline on track.

## FAQ
Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes. RWB Electrical Services is fully insured and state licensed.

Q: Do you do same-day repairs?
A: Yes. We offer same-day electrical repairs, one-day installations and turnkey generator installation.

Q: Is your work warranted?
A: Yes. Our work comes with a 5 Year Labor & Parts Warranty.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work in Harris, Montgomery and Chambers Counties, for both homes and businesses.

Q: Can you work with me if I'm out of town?
A: One reviewer was traveling while closing on a new home. The team set up the inspection with him by email and text and got the work done.
